title: KudiCubs Narration Lines
description: Source of truth for every spoken line (docs/design/narration/lines.json). Generates docs/design/narration-script.md and prototype/assets/data/audio-manifest.js (research R5). Text is what a human voice actor records; no line is ever synthesised.

languages.description: Recording languages with a folder under prototype/assets/audio/. en-GH is first (provisional, FR-021).

defaultLanguage.description: First recording language (provisional, pending client confirmation).

regionLanguage.description: Preferred recording language per region; falls back to defaultLanguage, then to the caption.

wordsPerMinute.description: Pace used to estimate line length (brief: 120–140).

id.description: Stable line ID; also the audio file name (<id>.m4a).

screen.description: Screen id from contracts/screen-flow (002) or 'any' for shared lines (e.g. nav labels).

idea.description: The one idea this line carries (FR-018).

region.description: Set only for region-specific lines (coin names, market examples, currency).

pronunciation.description: Optional phonetic hint for the actor, e.g. 'peh-SEH-wah'.
